rules.title: Berkeley rent control coverage (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to fully covered units: most multifamily units built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. Partially covered and exempt units are not subject to rent control.

coverage_conditions.summary: Rent control covers most multifamily units built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented individually under separate leases). Units that received a certificate of occupancy after June 1980, post-1995 single-family tenancies, most condominiums, and certain subsidized units are not covered.
coverage_conditions.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied 'Golden Duplex' (owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and an owner currently lives in one unit) is exempt; units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant are exempt.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Single-family homes covered only if the current tenancy began before 1996. Section 202 and Section 811 units, and units with Rental Supplement, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside or Project-based Section 8 subsidies in HUD-insured or HUD-held projects, are not rent controlled. Most condominiums are not covered.

rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied); unit where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties with an ADU where either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives. Not rent controlled: new construction with certificate of occupancy after June 1980, single-family tenancies beginning on or after Jan 1, 1996, most condominiums, and certain federally subsidized units.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.conflict_note: The guide says 'built before 1980' for fully covered units but 'Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980' for partially covered new construction, which leaves January to June 1980 unaddressed. The guide is a secondary summary and cites no code section.}

rules.title: Berkeley Just Cause for Eviction coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction protections apply to fully covered units and also to partially covered units, including post-June 1980 new construction, post-1995 single-family tenancies, and most condominiums. Only exempt unit types are outside the ordinance.

coverage_conditions.summary: All units that are fully or partially covered, including multifamily units built before 1980, new construction with a certificate of occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes, most condominiums, rooming houses and certain subsidized units. Exempt unit types are excluded.
coverage_conditions.owner_conditions: Golden Duplex with an owner living in one unit, and units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant, are exempt.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Exempt: tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units; nonprofit cooperatives.

rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex; unit where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant (if owner lived there when the tenancy started); post-Nov 7, 2018 tenancies on properties with an ADU where either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords of fully or partially covered units must pay interest on security deposits. Exempt unit types are not subject to the requirement.

coverage_conditions.summary: All fully covered and partially covered units, including post-June 1980 new construction, post-1995 single-family tenancies, most condominiums and certain subsidized units. Exempt unit types are excluded.
coverage_conditions.owner_conditions: Golden Duplex and owner shared kitchen or bath units are exempt.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Exempt: ADU properties with owner occupancy (tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018), university rental units, nonprofit cooperatives.

rules.exemptions: Golden Duplex; unit where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant; post-Nov 7, 2018 tenancies on ADU properties with an owner-occupied unit; university rental units; nonprofit cooperatives.
